core_obligations: Set up the dualizing data: the proof introduces a dualizing complex, its dimension function and the finite modules playing a central role in the argument, and it tells the reader to read the proof of the earlier annihilator proposition first (proof lines 3012-3020)

From annihilation to the depth inequality: assuming an ideal supported away from the larger subset annihilates the local cohomology in degrees up to the given bound, the proof derives the depth-and-dimension inequality of the second condition by localizing and running the local duality spectral sequence (proof lines 3020-3130)

From the inequality to annihilation: conversely, assuming the inequality for all pairs of primes, the proof constructs an ideal with support away from the larger subset that annihilates the local cohomology in the required degrees (proof lines 3130-3158)

Sharpness: the proof closes by showing, from the spectral sequence and a minimality argument, that the local cohomology module in the critical degree is not annihilated by any ideal of the required support, which finishes the equivalence (proof lines 3158-3164)
proof_roadmap: 先备好对偶复形 ω_A^∙ 及其维数函数 δ，并指出本命题是前一条 annihilator 命题的自然推广（建议先读那条）。
两个方向都在局部对偶谱序列上运行：由消失性得到 depth + dim 的不等式；反向由不等式构造出支撑避开 T' 的理想并证明它杀死低阶局部上同调；最后用取极小 i 的办法说明临界阶的上同调不可能被这样的理想杀死。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the annihilation criterion for bounded local cohomology of a coherent complex in terms of a depth-and-dimension inequality on pairs of primes (author proposition at source lines 2993-3010, label proposition-annihilator-complex). The proof (source lines 3012-3164) is a long argument in the dualizing-complex formalism: it sets up the dualizing complex and its dimension function, runs the local duality spectral sequence in both directions to pass between annihilation by a supported ideal and the numerical inequality (proof lines 3020-3158), and closes with a minimality argument showing the critical local cohomology module is not annihilated by any ideal of the required support (proof lines 3158-3164). Both directions and the sharpness step are written out; the author's remark that the earlier proposition's proof should be read first is a reading suggestion, not an omission. H2.
